external_research_inputs.title: How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_research_inputs.source_claim_used: A trained Transformer progressed from shallow heuristics to systematic variable dereferencing on assignment chains with distractors; causal interventions implicated residual-stream memory and routing heads in that tested architecture.
external_research_inputs.project_implication: Add variable-depth indirection, distractors, reorderings and causal counterfactuals to binding evaluation so surface heuristics cannot masquerade as systematic binding.

external_research_inputs.title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
external_research_inputs.source_claim_used: Fixed steering strength can be inconsistent across prompts; context-conditioned steering strength improved results across the reported benchmarks/model families.
external_research_inputs.project_implication: Treat one global steering gain as a baseline, not an architecture law; preregister context-conditioned gain/schedule candidates and matched controls for the exact target model.

external_research_inputs.title: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base model card
external_research_inputs.source_claim_used: The 0.8B language model has hidden dimension 1024 and 24 layers arranged as a hybrid of Gated DeltaNet and gated-attention blocks.
external_research_inputs.project_implication: Do not transfer an attention-only variable-binding mechanism or a generic layer/control-point assumption into Qwen3.5. Exact target checkpoint interventions must determine where binding/Hyperposition control is causally expressed.

required_successor_curriculum.design: For the same H_before/operation semantics, render reversible variants over branch order, field order, delimiters/wrapper names and compact-vs-explicit representation. Supervised H_after/resolution must remain equivalent modulo canonicalization.
required_successor_curriculum.shortcut_falsifier: Performance collapses when the literal HP_FRAME token, fixed branch position or field order changes while semantics are preserved.

required_successor_curriculum.design: Hold lexical surface nearly fixed while changing only evidence-for/evidence-against, context predicate, falsifier satisfaction or authorized discriminator result. The target transition must change exactly when the semantic relation changes.
required_successor_curriculum.shortcut_falsifier: Model preserves the old resolution despite a causally decisive relation change.

required_successor_curriculum.design: Train H_before -> REQUEST_DISCRIMINATOR/UNRESOLVED -> new evidence -> H_after sequences; include insufficient-evidence episodes where retaining alternatives is the correct completion.
required_successor_curriculum.shortcut_falsifier: Model collapses branches merely to produce a definite answer.

required_successor_curriculum.design: Project one context view without deleting nonprojected branches, then change context and require correct branch re-entry from the preserved backing Hyperposition state.
required_successor_curriculum.shortcut_falsifier: Previously nonprojected branches cannot be recovered without restating them as new facts.

required_successor_curriculum.design: Extend binding tests with variable-depth alias/indirection chains, irrelevant distractor chains, ordering perturbations and query-dependent dereferencing. Keep family/provenance split isolation.
required_successor_curriculum.evidence_boundary: General variable-binding research motivates the discriminator; it is not positive Qwen3.5 mechanism evidence.

required_successor_curriculum.design: Compare fixed gain to context-conditioned gain/schedule and layer/token control points with no-op, shuffled, sign-flip/lesion and rescue controls on the exact pinned target checkpoint.
required_successor_curriculum.evidence_boundary: External steering results guide test design only; no Qwen3.5 J-Space credit is transferred.

counterhypotheses.claim: A small 0.8B model may need one stable explicit Hyperposition serialization; aggressive serialization variation could consume capacity and reduce useful state-transition learning.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Train/evaluate matched pilots with canonical-only versus canonical-plus-equivalent-serialization curriculum; compare canonical accuracy, unseen-serialization invariance, retention and sample efficiency.

counterhypotheses.claim: Observed codebook failure may arise mainly from prompt topology/position/polarity nuisance rather than missing episode-local binding computation.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Factor topology/order/position independently of mapping and measure whether mapping generalization remains impaired after nuisance control.

counterhypotheses.claim: Correct serialized H_after output might be generated without changing internal decision dynamics.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Require lesion/shuffle/rescue and downstream re-entry consequences; output format correctness alone cannot promote causal J-Space/Hyperposition credit.

promotion_gates: Do not scale semantic Hyperposition rows until equivalent-serialization and minimal-relation counterfactual pilot tests pass at rendered-byte scope.
Do not render binder symbols until exact accepted-only 46-atom ABI inventory, exact target tokenizer identity and tokenization/position contract are semantically authenticated.
Construct TRAIN/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT from one immutable split manifest with disjoint semantic/provenance families; split names or family prefixes do not prove independence.
Keep hard-negative rejection supervision typed separately from one-symbol production where output grammars differ.
Freeze pre-training READ/BIND/WRITE/retention baselines before any training execution.
Any future behavioral gain receives behavioral scope only; causal Global J-Space/Hyperposition promotion additionally requires exact-checkpoint interventions and matched controls.
next_exact_action: Extend the retained PR1956 universal Hyperposition lane with a small equivalence/counterfactual rendered pilot only after exact ABI/tokenizer semantic materialization is available; require canonical-only versus serialization-augmented baseline comparison before corpus-scale promotion.
